statement: The old refrigerator alcove is 40 in wide and 34 in deep
rationale: nobody measured it; the sizes are read from a photo of a 36 in refrigerator standing in it. Under 36 in wide it will not take pantry cabinets; under 30 in deep it is a reach-in, not a walk-in

mechanism.how: Measure the alcove wall to wall and front to back with a tape, at the floor and at 6 ft
